title: Installed launcher no longer leaks caller pipes into detached children
goal: When the installed entry hands a command to another release slot (the dispatcher fallback), the release inherited the dispatcher's own stdio handles as extra inheritable handles, so a daemon it detached kept the caller's pipes open and a captured `susi start` blocked until the daemon exited. The fallback now spawns through spawn_without_inheriting_stdio. Measured by the new fixture test: 190 s before, 12.6 s after (debug build).
